data.desc: Root Insurance is a technology company revolutionizing car insurance through data science and automation. Founded in 2015 and based in Columbus, Ohio, Root, Inc. ( NASDAQ: ROOT ) is the parent company of Root Property & Casualty Insurance Company. The Root app has reached more than 18 million downloads and has analyzed more than 38 billion miles of driving data to deliver personalized, easy, and fair pricing. Root is available in 39 states and offers car insurance to consumers across the United States through its direct-to-consumer channel, independent insurance agents, and distribution partners.
